title: Instagram → Google Business Profile auto-poster
summary: A Zapier recipe that mirrors every new Instagram post to your Google Business Profile as a 'What's new' post, with hashtags stripped and Reels skipped. Good for local SEO.
how_to_use: Follow RUNBOOK.md step by step. clean-caption.js is the Zapier code step.
requires: Zapier, an Instagram Business account linked to a Facebook Page, and a Google Business Profile.
